jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Job Overview We are seeking a skilled, execution-focused Data Engineer to join our Data & Analytics team. This role is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable, production-grade data pipelines on the Databricks Lakehouse Platform. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with Python, PySpark, SQL, and medallion architecture, along with a proven record of delivering reliable data solutions in enterprise environments. You will report directly to the Sr. Data Architect and collaborate closely with business analysts, architects, BI developers, and offshore engineering teams to meet enterprise data delivery needs. This role requires deep technical expertise, a strong execution mindset, and the ability to adapt as the platform evolves to support generative AI, agent-based automation, and intelligent orchestration frameworks. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain ELT pipelines on Databricks using Python, PySpark, and SQL, following medallion architecture patterns (Bronze, Silver, Gold) Package, version, and deploy reusable pipeline components using Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs) Implement and manage CI/CD workflows across environments using Azure DevOps or GitHub Perform code reviews and provide delivery oversight for offshore data engineering teams, ensuring quality, consistency, and adherence to standards Participate in sprint planning, technical design reviews, and architecture discussions Proactively identify, troubleshoot, and resolve data quality, performance, and reliability issues Evaluate and adopt emerging tools and approaches, including LLMs, GenAI, and agent-based workflows, to modernize and automate data delivery Support data modeling, lineage, and governance practices using Unity Catalog and related tooling Maintain clear technical documentation and communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field 3+ years of hands-on data engineering experience delivering production workloads Strong experience with Databricks, Python, PySpark, and SQL Experience troubleshooting and debugging Terraform deployments, state management, module configurations, and cloud infrastructure issues. Solid understanding of Delta Lake and medallion architecture design principles Experience using Azure DevOps or GitHub for version control and CI/CD automation Proven ability to support or lead offshore engineering teams while maintaining delivery accountability Experience with Azure-based data platforms preferred Databricks certification (Associate Data Engineer or higher) preferred Palantir platform knowledge or experience is a plus Interest in or exposure to GenAI, agent tooling, and modern orchestration or ML workflows Strong written and verbal communication skills Skills And Competencies High attention to detail with a quality-first mindset Strong ownership and accountability for deliverables Ability to operate effectively in a hybrid onshore and offshore delivery model Well-organized, self-directed, and comfortable managing multiple priorities Willingness to learn new tools, patterns, and frameworks as the platform evolves Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment Working Conditions Ability to work remotely Occasional travel may be required Flexible work hours may be necessary to meet project timelines Salary Range $115,000 - $120,000 annually, depending upon experience Company Overview Primoris Services Corporation is a premier specialty contractor providing critical infrastructure services to the utility, energy, and renewables markets throughout the United States and Canada. Built on a foundation of trust, we deliver a range of engineering, construction, and maintenance services that power, connect, and enhance society. On projects spanning utility-scale solar, renewables, power delivery, communications, and transportation infrastructure, we offer unmatched value to our clients, a safe and entrepreneurial culture to our employees, and innovation and excellence to our communities. To learn more, visit www.prim.com and follow us on social media at @PrimorisServicesCorporation. jobs.title: Data Engineer, Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation
jobs.description: Description Are you passionate about sustainability and waste reduction efforts across Amazon's global organization? Are you interested in building the data foundation that drives solutions balancing packaging and automation to increase speed, reduce cost, and ultimately delight our customers? The Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation team is looking for a Data Engineer to join us in building and maintaining the end-to-end data pipelines and infrastructure that power our analytics and business decisions. This is your opportunity to be a core part of the team that reduces waste for our business and our customers. In this role, you will design, build, and operate the data pipelines behind our "source of truth" data store and metrics for warehouse automation and customer packaging. You will develop robust, scalable ETL/ELT solutions that integrate large, complex data spanning many sources and data structures using AWS tools, enabling data-driven decisions on OEE, machine metrics, and product performance across our packaging automation, IB sortation, and other warehouse automation products. We are looking for a builder with deep SQL proficiency, strong Python skills, and knowledge of data modeling and warehousing best practices. You will apply rigorous data quality and data security practices, including validation, deduplication, PII handling, access controls, and monitoring, so that stakeholders can trust the data and sensitive operational data stays protected as it moves through our pipelines. You'll partner closely with Business Intelligence Engineers, Data Scientists, Product, and Operations to translate raw data into reliable, well-governed datasets and actionable insights. The ideal candidate thrives amid ambiguity, builds for the future while delivering today, and understands the importance of code development best practices. If you love hard problems with many solutions and a diverse, results-oriented environment, come join us! Key job responsibilities Be hands-on with ETL/ELT to build and maintain reliable, scalable data pipelines using SQL, Python, and Spark that support automated reporting for warehouse automation and customer packaging Interface with other technology teams to extract, transform, and load data from a wide variety of sources spanning warehouse automation and customer packaging Implement data structures using best practices in data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, SQL, and Redshift, and manage our "source of truth" data stores Implement best practices in batch and real-time data processing to make pipelines performant Apply strong data quality practices (validation, deduplication, PII handling, drift detection, and monitoring) so consumers can trust the data Build data security and access controls into the data infrastructure, protecting sensitive operational and performance data throughout its lifecycle Model data and metadata for ad-hoc and pre-built reporting, and deliver high-quality datasets to support BIEs, Data Scientists, and customer reporting needs Manage and optimize cloud computing resources on AWS to support data infrastructure Use AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Amazon Q, Kiro) to accelerate pipeline development, SQL, and debugging, while validating generated output for correctness Create extensible, easy-to-maintain designs with a long-term vision, laying groundwork to support future machine learning and GenAI use cases Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions A day in the life As a Data Engineer on this team, you will own the end-to-end data pipelines and infrastructure that serve as our "source of truth" for warehouse automation and customer packaging metrics. You will design, build, and operate robust and scalable ETL/ELT solutions, integrating complex data from dozens of sources to enable data-driven decisions across the Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation Organization. You will partner closely with Business Intelligence Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers, Product Managers, and Operations teams to translate raw requirements into reliable and scalable data pipelines producing datasets that can be used and trusted across the org. You will also champion data quality and security practices, ensuring stakeholders can trust the data while sensitive operational information stays protected throughout its lifecycle. Basic Qualifications 1+ years of data engineering experience 2+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience Bachelor's degree in a quantitative/technical field such as computer science, engineering, statistics Knowledge of distributed systems as it pertains to data storage and computing Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines Experience with one or more query language (e.g., SQL, PL/SQL, DDL, MDX, HiveQL, SparkSQL, Scala) Experience with one or more scripting language (e.g., Python, KornShell) Preferred Qualifications Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR Experience with any ETL tool like, Informatica, ODI, SSIS, BODI, Datastage, etc. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. jobs.title: Software Engineer II Data
jobs.description: Job Summary The Software Engineer II, Data builds and supports enterprise data ingestion, transformation, modeling, and integration solutions. This role translates business and source-system requirements into scalable, maintainable data solutions that support analytics, reporting, operational, and downstream application needs. What You Will Do Build ingestion and transformation solutions using Microsoft Fabric and Azure Data Factory. Implement pipelines supporting batch, incremental, API, file, database, and event-based integration patterns. Develop reusable and configuration-driven ingestion and transformation patterns where appropriate. Build curated data structures supporting analytics, reporting, operational, and downstream application requirements. Work with structured and semi-structured data, including SQL, CSV, JSON, XML, Parquet, and similar enterprise formats. Work with Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake/Storage and Azure SQL/SQL Server. Translate business and source-system requirements into scalable data models. Participate in conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling. Design dimensional and curated models that support enterprise reporting and analytics. Develop complex SQL queries, views, transformations, and data-processing logic. Troubleshoot query, pipeline, and data-processing issues. Perform query and pipeline performance tuning. Identify and resolve data-quality, integrity, completeness, and consistency issues. Perform source-to-target and source-to-source reconciliation. Develop validation checks for new pipelines and changes. Use GitHub for source control and branch-based development. Follow EDAS CI/CD, pull-request, code-review and design-review standards. Use Azure DevOps (ADO) and approved engineering practices to manage delivery. Create maintainable, reusable, well-documented code. Participate actively in peer code and design reviews. Create or improve reusable engineering patterns and supporting documentation. What We Expect Of You Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Engineering, or a related field and 3 years of relevant IT experience, OR 7 total years of relevant IT experience. Professional experience developing enterprise data pipelines, integrations, data warehouses, Lakehouse solutions, or analytics data platforms. Ability to deliver effectively in an Agile enterprise engineering environment. Strong SQL and relational database development. Strong understanding of data engineering and ETL/ELT. Microsoft Fabric. Azure Data Factory (ADF). Azure Data Lake / Storage. Azure SQL / SQL Server. Data warehousing and dimensional/data modeling concepts. Data ingestion and transformation patterns. Data validation and reconciliation. Performance optimization and troubleshooting. Git / GitHub. CI/CD and pull-request-based development. Azure DevOps / Agile delivery practices. Enterprise data governance and data-quality concepts, a plus. Microsoft Fabric / Azure data engineering certifications, a plus. Pay range: $86,000 - $119,000, depending on experience and skill set. jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer - Data Connectors
jobs.description: A World-Changing Company Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. The Role The Connectivity team builds the software that connects Palantir’s platform to customer systems. Our connectors integrate databases, enterprise applications, cloud storage, web services, and streaming systems, enabling customers to bring data into Foundry and write back to their operational systems. From large datasets to real-time events and user-driven interactions, these connections underpin the applications and AI workflows customers build with Foundry and AIP. You’ll build and maintain Foundry’s first-class connector suite and the shared infrastructure behind it. You’ll work across the stack, taking ownership of connector implementations, developer SDKs, and the systems that build, test, distribute, and run our connectivity software. A central part of this work is evolving and scaling a large, established codebase. You’ll move integrations from bespoke infrastructure onto shared platform capabilities, design SDKs that enable other teams and customers to build integrations independently, and safely retire older implementations. You’ll also build observability and diagnostic tools that help users understand, monitor, and troubleshoot their connections. You’ll own improvements from design through production and use what you learn from operating connectors to strengthen the platform they share.
